issues.evidence: Only the quote-aware lexical scanner decides whether a physical # line is a comment. RFC-decoded first cells are never reclassified as comments, and first-column leading-# export data is RFC-quoted so Incidence CSV round-trips.

H2H export availability is structured for computed, unrepresentable, over-budget, and not-requested states. Non-computed results retain diagnostic preview text but return ok:false before any downloader side effect and never return a filename.

contracts.commentAuthority: A full physical line is ignored only when its first non-whitespace character is # outside RFC quotes. Post-decoding firstCell.startsWith('#') filtering is prohibited.
contracts.leadingHashSerialization: A first-column data value beginning with # is RFC-quoted so its physical row cannot be mistaken for a comment.
contracts.nonComputedH2HDownload: Preview and copy retain diagnostics; Download returns before dl(), reports no successful filename, and does not force projection computation.

deferredRisks.note: Matrix and Clique descriptors were intentionally not redesigned in this corrective. Their result/download availability contracts should be audited in the appropriate later stage.
